question: Which plan is our workspace on, and can we use SSO?

model.source: recorded from claude-opus-5-5 through the anthropic provider

replies.text: Kitewood Studio (w_kitewood) is on the **Business plan**, billed annually since 2026-09-08, with 42 seats. I can't confirm whether the Business plan includes SSO, because none of the help articles I have say which plans offer it. What I do know is that in a workspace that requires SSO, members can't sign in with a password. They choose Sign in with SSO and enter their work email instead [help:sign-in@6#3]. To check whether SSO is available on your plan and how to set it up, for example with Okta, please contact support@fernway.example.
